name: claude-plugin-to-codex
description: Port a Claude Code plugin to OpenAI Codex, as a plugin: manifest translation, skills with rewritten path anchors and host-valid names, PreToolUse hooks run natively by Codex, MCP servers, rules file. Installs locally with `codex plugin add`, or builds a portable bundle that installs by unzipping. The Codex command of the claude-plugin-port engine.
author: Flavien Chervet
